title: Same-`at` collapse silently drops the terminal line on legacy taken-over (warm-handoff) rows
evidence:
client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:1430:
      [prev, ..rest] if prev.at == line.at -> acc
server/src/reference_checks/sql/take_over_reference_call.sql:20-22:
SET taken_over_at = now(),
    next_attempt_at = NULL,
    updated_at = now()
server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam:1437:
    #("taken_over", normalize_at(taken_over_at)),
server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam:1461:
          normalize_at(updated_at),
detail: A legacy unreachable row (terminalized pre-RC4.4, terminalized_at NULL) taken over post-migration: the takeover UPDATE stamps taken_over_at and updated_at with one now(). The builder's terminal fallback lands on updated_at — identical to the taken_over entry's at, so the collapse drops the terminal line from both timeline and export.
recommended_fix: Make collapse_same_at_sends kind-aware (drop only when kind AND at match), so distinct event classes sharing a timestamp both render.

title: `failed` (and v2 `completed`) rows get wrong terminal label and export outcome
detail: sweep_mark_failed sets status 'failed' (v1-reachable), and the server builder emits a terminal entry for it. Neither new copy function has a failed arm, so a failed row's evidence export reads "Outcome: In progress" and its timeline terminal line reads "Closed", hiding the failure.
recommended_fix: Add "failed" (and "completed") arms to refcheck_timeline_terminal and refcheck_export_outcome with honest labels, e.g. "Send failed".

title: Skipped co-nudge renders a dangling " — " because the wire entry ships empty detail
evidence:
client/src/components/reference_panel.gleam:1455:
          copy.refcheck_timeline_nudge_skipped <> " — " <> skipped.detail
server/src/application/application_detail_handler.gleam:1373-1376:
    let detail = case cycle_index {
      n if n >= 2 -> int.to_string(n - 1)
      _ -> ""
    }
server/src/reference_checks/sweep.gleam:830:
    #("detail", json.string(reason)),
detail: The stored attempt carries the skip reason ("co-nudge skipped: form already opened"), which RC4.3 displayed. build_send_entries ships detail only for reminders, so the new payload's skipped co-nudge has detail ""; nudge_label unconditionally joins " — " + detail, rendering a trailing dash and losing the reason.
recommended_fix: Guard the " — " join on non-empty detail, or have build_send_entries carry the attempt's detail for co_nudge entries.

title: Cadence hint counts batches across correction cycles, hiding "what happens next" while cycle-2 reminders are pending
detail: A correction resets attempt_count and re-runs the full cadence, so a corrected row can carry 5+ send batches. The hint compares the ALL-cycles batch count against 4: at 4 total batches (cycle-2 Reminder 1 done) it hides while cycle-2 Reminder 2 is still due.
recommended_fix: Count send batches only since the latest `corrected` entry, or let the server ship a next-step-pending flag.
